scripts.test: sh -c 'node "$([ -d exact_scripts ] && echo exact_scripts || echo scripts)/test-runner.mjs" fast'
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'node "$([ -d exact_scripts ] && echo exact_scripts || echo scripts)/test-runner.mjs" integration'
scripts.test:skills: sh -c 'node "$([ -d exact_scripts ] && echo exact_scripts || echo scripts)/test-runner.mjs" skills'
scripts.test:skills:profiles: sh -c 'node "$([ -d exact_scripts ] && echo exact_scripts || echo scripts)/test-runner.mjs" skills:profiles'
scripts.test:smoke: sh -c 'output=$(PI_OFFLINE=1 pi --no-session --no-context-files --list-models __pi_smoke_no_match__ 2>&1); status=$?; printf "%s\n" "$output"; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; ! printf "%s\n" "$output" | grep -q "\[Extension issues\]"'
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run typecheck && npm run test:smoke
